title: THE WATER SPLIT.
paragraphs: THE WATER SPLIT.

Not because Israel was strong.
Not because Moses was fearless.
Not because Pharaoh changed his mind.
The water split because God made a road where panic said, “You’re finished.”

Exodus 14 is not just a sea story.
It is a salvation story.

Behind them: slavery.
Before them: impossible water.
Around them: fear, screaming, confusion.
And in that crushing moment, God did not say, “Figure it out.”

He said, “Stand firm… and you will see the deliverance of the Lord.”
Then He made the sea obey.

That is grace.
Grace does not wait for a door.
Grace builds one.

Some of you are standing at your own Red Sea right now.
A marriage cracking.
A habit you cannot break.
A past that keeps chasing you like Pharaoh’s army.
You prayed, but the waves stayed.
You cried, but the pressure did not move.
Listen to me, beloved:
What looks like your end may become the stage for God’s glory.

The same water that became a pathway for God’s people
became judgment for their enemies.
Do you see it?

What God opens, no devil can shut.
What God closes, no empire can revive.
And this points beyond Moses.

Because the deepest sea was never the Red Sea.
It was the gulf between a holy God and sinful people.
And we could not cross it.
So Jesus stepped in.

At the cross, He made a way through judgment.
At the resurrection, He opened the path no sinner could open for himself.
Sin said, “Drowned.”
Grace said, “Walk through.”

That is the Gospel.
Not that you were strong enough to swim.
But that Christ was mighty enough to save.

So when the road disappears, do not worship the obstacle.
Trust the God who commands the waters.

He still makes ways in impossible places.
He still leads trembling people on dry ground.
He still turns impossible nights into testimonies.

THE WATER SPLIT.
And if God can part seas, He can part the thing that has held you hostage.

Come to Jesus.
Repent.
Trust the Savior who makes a way where none existed.
Grace makes a way where none existed.
